entities.name: Mehdi Mujahid
entities.label: Person
entities.summary: Mahdi Mujahid was an Afghan Hazara rebel. He was formerly a Taliban commander before he defected and led around 200 Hazara fighters during the Balkhab uprising. He was killed in action on 17 August 2022.
